headline: Papa John's Completes First UK Purchase via Cardless AI Agent
summary: A Papa John's order of nine mini pizzas became the first purchase in the UK made using an AI agent via cardless payment technology without sharing bank security details.
why: AI-driven commerce and cardless payment technologies represent a potentially disruptive shift in retail transaction methods and digital consumer platforms.

impacts.name: Papa John's
impacts.why: Papa John's was used for the first UK AI agent cardless purchase.
